Java Lesson 1 - Hello WOrld
assignments.description:
Complete after doing the Hello World lesson on Codecademy. The goal of this lesson is to learn how to create workspaces in VSCode, run java projects, and submit assignments on Classroom50. Connor will walk you through cloning the repository that is created when you accept this assignment.

Your task:
Print "Hello <your name>" to the console.

assignments.name: Java Lesson 2 -- Variables
assignments.description:
Your Task:
Save the following information in Variables. Think about what data type each variable should use, and use understandable names for each one (ex. Don't name your age variable "Bob"; name it "age"). Then, print out each of your variables.
- Your name
- Your age
- Whether you're right or left handed (Don't use a String)
- Hours of sleep last night (use decimals if applicable)
